description: This source file defines a Razor view component named 'Basket' for an ASP.NET Core web application, responsible for displaying and managing the shopping basket contents, including counting total items via user identity or anonymous cookie.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: A view component class for rendering the shopping basket component, handling item count calculations based on user sign-in status or anonymous cookies.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates the view model with item count and returns the view result.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously counts total items in the basket, based on whether the user is signed in or anonymous.

methods.name: GetAnnonymousIdFromCookie
methods.description: Retrieves the anonymous basket ID from cookies if available and valid.
